attestations.note: The life page /2150/ heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives the pair one sentence: «Οι Άγιοι Δάσιος και Μάρων μαρτύρησαν δια ξίφους» — they were martyred by the sword. He is not the corpus's `dasius-of-axiopolis`, whose Romanian row stands on 26 Απριλίου and who is kept there with Cyril and Quindeus of the same city: another day and another company. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on this page; the day's «Άγιος Ιωάννης Θ' Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινούπολης *» does carry it and is refused. No year, no place and no judge is printed, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`, and the page prints no hymn.
